name: Dreamscape VR: Hidden China
summary:
Leave the noise of everyday life behind and embark on a dreamlike aerial journey through some of China’s most extraordinary and rarely seen landscapes.
Aboard the mythical Sky Lantern, you will drift effortlessly between earth and sky, floating above golden deserts, sacred lakes, snow-covered peaks, endless grasslands, and surreal natural wonders shaped over thousands of years.
More than a travel experience, Hidden China is a cinematic journey designed for moments of wonder, stillness, and discovery. Throug
